about: Hand decisions about MH5 stat blocks, applied by scripts/msh/roster.py after scripts/msh/coverpanels.py parses them. Every one was read off the page image; none is a guess from OCR.
Facts only - ranks, numbers and labels, never the book's prose - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.
match     {page, header}: a card or one-line grid; page is the printed Adventure page, or null for a card on a cover panel (which prints no page)
verdict   misprint          the book prints a value its own ranks contradict; 'printed' keeps what the page says, 'corrected' what the ranks give; 'also' a second value of the same block

text              match {row}: an msh_book_text row key. 'read' is a fragment of a few words as the OCR gives it after folding to ASCII, 'printed' the same fragment as the page prints it. It must occur once in the row, or npcs.py stops.
checked   the date the page image was read

overrides.note: Printed 12, the card: Reason Amazing, Intuition Remarkable, Psyche Incredible, so R+I+P is 50 + 30 + 40 = 120, and the card prints Karma 125 (read on the page image). Health 56 = Gd 10 + Gd 10 + Ty 6 + Rm 30 as printed. Survey mh5.md decision 4 (recommended, applied unanswered): a misprint override with both values (not taken: as_printed).

Survey mh5.md decision 4 (recommended, applied unanswered): the Health as the override and the Karma in its also.
